title: Dislocated Geodes
text: Rolling cave floors and ceilings meet the surrounding caverns. Pale-blue-to-pink Deflection Crystal replaces much of the rough spatial crystal. Budding crystals and clusters form at the exposed tips of opposing crystal cones.

Stepping onto a Deflection Crystal Block in this biome gradually bends your travel left or right by 10 degrees. A Spacetime Anchoring Sigil prevents this floor effect, and blocks outside the biome are harmless. Clusters curve your path wherever they are placed, and the sigil does not protect against them.
